name: cloud-harness-workspaces
description: Work in authorized remote coding workspaces on your own self-hosted Cloud Harness MCP endpoint, with read-first inspection, bounded execution, and explicit cleanup.

mcpUrl.title: Cloud Harness MCP URL
mcpUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the Cloud Harness MCP endpoint you operate, such as https://harness.example.com/mcp. Sign-in happens through the endpoint's OAuth flow; the plugin stores no credential.
